\begin{table}[htbp]
\centering
\small
\caption{Which method in which situation.}
\label{tab:decision}
\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{%
\begin{tabular}{lllll}
\toprule
Situation & Recommended & Runner-up & Rule applied to this run & Evidence \\
\midrule
Missing at random, moderate size & softImpute & MICE-Long & lowest mean nRMSE (MCAR, MAR) & nRMSE 0.616 \\
Values lost below a detection limit (MNAR) & MICE-LongMNAR & MICE-Long & lowest mean nRMSE over the MNAR and LOD designs; report the gamma grid & nRMSE 1.163 \\
Uncertainty must be carried forward (multiple imputation) & MICE-Long & MICE-LongMNAR & lowest nRMSE among MI methods whose 95\% intervals cover 90-100\% under MCAR & coverage 95\% \\
Large cohorts (100,000 rows and more) & softImpute & LOCF & lowest nRMSE among methods finishing within 300 s at 100,000 rows & nRMSE 0.616 \\
Within-patient change is the outcome & MICE-Long & MICE-LongMNAR & per-completion SD ratio (MCAR, MAR) closest to 1 among MI methods; completions pooled by Rubin's rules & mean |SD ratio - 1| = 0.029 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}

}
\end{table}
